seo.description: The KLUB teaching team: internationally certified reformer Pilates instructors with classical dance foundations, trained and experienced in London and Dubai studios. Pre/post-natal qualified.

hero.heading: Our *Instructors*
hero.lede: Classically trained. Internationally certified. Experienced in some of the world's best studios — and the reason your form is about to get very, very good.

journey.title: Trained where movement is a language
journey.body: Our teaching is built on classical dance education at degree level — training from one of the world's most respected movement traditions. Years of classical discipline teach what most fitness certifications never do: how bodies actually learn to move, and how to teach with precision and patience.
journey.imageAlt: Instructor mid-movement on a reformer, one arm extended, in a bright curtained studio

journey.title: Experience from world-class studios
journey.body: Our instructors have taught reformer Pilates in some of the region's most beautiful studios, training clients of every level — athletes, beginners, mothers, executives. It's where classical technique meets contemporary studio culture: teaching that is exacting, warm, and impossible to get lost in.
journey.imageAlt: Premium black reformer machine beside a bright curtained window at KLUB

journey.title: Movement broken down until it clicks
journey.body: Thousands of hours of teaching — in studios and on camera — shape how we coach: every movement explained, every rep watched, every exercise adapted to the body in front of us. Classes are built on classical foundations and delivered with a contemporary flow.

journey.title: Bringing that standard to Cyprus
journey.body: KLUB is the studio we always wanted to walk into: bright, calm, seriously equipped, and small enough that every client is known by name. London's discipline, Dubai's polish, the island's soul — all under one roof in Limassol city center. The reformers are already on the floor.
journey.imageAlt: Row of reformer Pilates machines on the floor of the KLUB studio in Limassol

quote.text: Pilates gives dancers strength without bulk, control without tension. It does the same for every body that walks in — you just have to *start*.

follow.heading: Follow the *journey*
follow.text: The studio is taking shape week by week. Follow @klubstudios for previews of the space, the equipment and the classes — and be the first to know when the timetable goes live.
